# Rajiv K Chawla

> Business coach and mentor for India's MSMEs, manufacturers and family businesses. Founder & Chairman of Jairaj Group of Industries and I AM SME OF INDIA. Over 40 years as a founder, promoter and operator in Indian manufacturing.

## About

Rajiv K Chawla mentors owners of mid-size Indian businesses on the half of the job most run blind on: government schemes and subsidies, company structure and governance, succession and family constitution, capital beyond the CC limit, legal and compliance, and peer learning with owners at the same scale.

Positions held include the Board of NSIC (6 years), China Trust Commercial Bank (4 years), and the MSE Facilitation Council (12 years), along with government committees including SIPEC and RAMP. He has mentored 800+ business owners and is an author and columnist on ownership and entrepreneurship in India.

## GAPS — Growth Accelerator Program for SMEs

A twelve-month executive programme, by application only, built and led by Rajiv K Chawla. Not a course. It rests on three pillars: Personalised Support (seven counsels, one relationship), Structured Training (24 expert-led online sessions plus 6 in-person events, 30 touchpoints a year), and Astro-Numerology (a considered input alongside the numbers, never a replacement for them).

The six gaps it closes: government schemes and subsidies owners never claimed; company structure and governance; succession and family constitution; capital beyond the CC limit; legal, contracts and disputes; and peer learning with owners at the same scale.

The expert panel covers corporate governance, direct tax and financial health, GST and indirect tax, wealth management, central and state subsidy schemes, growth and go-to-market, and Supreme Court legal counsel.

Additional benefit: selected members are nominated for a fully sponsored 21-day manufacturing immersion in Germany, travel and stay covered.

### Pricing
GAPS Premium: ₹2,40,000 + GST for a full year. Includes the full seven-counsel panel as an extended team, direct access to Rajiv K Chawla, 24 expert-led online sessions, 6 in-person events, nomination for the Germany training, subsidy discovery and filing support, legal, tax, structuring and succession work, and an astro consultation and report.

### How to apply
1. A 15-minute call about your business
2. Mutual fit check on sector, stage and intent
3. Enrol and meet your team
